notices.coupleDisclaimerBody: This is an early version of Amora — we're actively upgrading it, and it'll run more smoothly as it grows. It's AI, so it can make mistakes sometimes. One more thing: recreating a theme captures its overall look and vibe, not an exact copy every time. Full details anytime in Profile → About This App.

about.title: About Amora
about.versionSectionBody: Amora is a new app, still growing. We're actively upgrading it, and it'll run more smoothly as more of it gets built out — thank you for being here this early.
about.aiSectionBody: Every wallpaper here is generated by an AI model, not hand-made. It can make mistakes sometimes — an odd detail, a feature that doesn't quite match, a style that doesn't land the way you expected. If a result looks off, trying again (or adjusting the description) often helps.
about.themeSectionBody: "Recreating" a template or someone's post captures that scene's overall look, mood, and composition — it isn't a pixel-for-pixel copy from A to Z. Expect the same vibe, not an identical duplicate, every time.
about.communitySectionBody: Sharing a creation puts it on everyone's Home feed, where others can view it or recreate it themselves. Every 100 times your post gets recreated by someone else, you earn 1 point — redeemable in Profile for spendable credits. Your own views on your own post, and recreating your own post, don't count toward this.
about.creditsSectionBody: Generating a wallpaper costs credits — 1 for a solo photo, 3 for a couple fusion (it makes three images: together, and a solo portrait of each of you). New accounts start with a few free credits to try it out.
about.licensesSectionBody: Amora is built with the help of open-source software and AI models. Tap to see what's inside.
about.licensesIntro: Amora is built on open-source software. We're grateful to the people who make it, and this page credits every package bundled into this app, as their licenses require.
about.licensesFontsBody: Manrope and Playfair Display are free and open-source fonts. The OFL permits using, studying, modifying, and redistributing them, alone or bundled with software, provided the fonts themselves are never sold on their own.
about.licensesAiBody: Amora's photo generation is powered by Google's Gemini API under Google's own API terms. Face and skin-tone correction runs on Google's MediaPipe and OpenCV (both Apache License 2.0) on Amora's own servers — they're not bundled into this app, but we wanted you to know what's behind the scenes.
